description:
Du sorgst für eine sorgfältige und proaktive Steuerung der Krankentaggelddossiers und stützt dich dabei auf die verschiedenen Instrumente des betrieblichen Gesundheitsmanagements Du bist die direkte Ansprechperson für ein Portefeuille von Unternehmenskunden und stellst diese in den Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns Du schaffst solide Vertrauensbeziehungen zu unseren Kunden und Versicherten

Groupe Mutuel is one of Switzerland's leading insurance groups, headquartered in Martigny (Valais). The company offers a wide range of insurance and pension products for individuals and businesses across Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it: Garantisci una gestione attenta e proattiva dei dossier dell'indennità giornaliera di malattia, basandoti sui diversi strumenti di gestione della salute in azienda Sei l'interlocutore diretto di un portafoglio di clienti aziendali e li metti al centro delle nostre azioni Crei solide relazioni di fiducia con i nostri clienti e assicurati Groupe Mutuel is one of Switzerland's leading insurance groups, headquartered in Martigny (Valais). La società offre una vasta gamma di prodotti assicurativi e pensionistici per gli individui e le imprese in tutta la Svizzera.
descriptionByLocale.en: You ensure careful and proactive management of daily sickness benefit files, relying on the various instruments of occupational health management. You are the direct contact person for a portfolio of corporate customers and put them at the centre of our actions. You create solid relationships of trust with our customers and insureds. Groupe Mutuel is one of Switzerland's leading insurance groups, headquartered in Martigny (Valais).
